variability.interpretation: Independent engineering scenario variability, not measured uncertainty. One noninteger frequency per disjoint band; common forcing and support values for all fault levels within a group.

limitations: T labels are simulated absolute lumped tool-node motion, with no validated 15 mm section mapping or real geometric probe runout.
Shaft XY labels are separately retained; neither shaft nor tool labels come from integrating housing velocity.
Position labels use unbandpassed native displacement states; only velocity inputs use the common 10–2048 Hz FIR.
Severity is a mechanical parameter; peak-to-peak motion is not forced to vary monotonically with severity.
Support and force variation are engineering sampling priors, not identified distributions of this spindle.
The base model is calibrated only to 1X amplitudes and has known platform phase mismatch.
Only 12 independent excitation/parameter groups exist; their one-second slices are technical windows, not independent runs.
Test groups are generated and stored but must not be used for training decisions.
